name: Tarnwyn Umbra
keeps: the names of everyone who came through
does: Signs at one door and no other. If she will not sign, that door does not move.
reason: Held that the stars were suns with worlds of their own.
text: Tarnwyn umbra of the fourth watch, keeps a door for the 13th tranche, doors 115 to 123. Keeps the names of everyone who came through. Reads Giordano Bruno.
